content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי אִבֵּי עֶדְנֵי מִצְוֹתָיו הִשְׂבִּיעָֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai ibbē ‘adnē mitsvotav hishbi‘anu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has sated us with the luscious produce of His commandments?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי הַמּוֹרֶה בְיֹֽשֶׁר, וּבְחֻקֵּי;יְפַת תֹֽאַר הִשְׁמִיעָֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai hammorē veyosher, uvḥuḳḳē yefat to’ar hishmi‘anu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has taught us in an upright way, and informed us of the laws of the beautiful woman?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי רַעְיוֹנֵֽינוּ טִהֵר, וְצִוָּה עַל־בְּכוֹר לְהַכִּירֵֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai ra‘yonenu tiher, vetsivva ‘al bekhor lehakkirenu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has made our thoughts pure, and commanded us to recognize the firstborn?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי נְתִיב צֶֽדֶק לְכָל־דָּבָר הוֹרָֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai netiv tsedeḳ lekhol davar horanu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has taught us the righteous path for every matter?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי לְבֵן סוֹרֵר וּמוֹרֶה רָז הִנְחִילָֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai leven sorer umorē raz hinḥilanu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has bequeathed us the mystery of the wayward and rebellious son?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי לְדִין נִתְלֶה מִכָּל־גּוֹי הִבְדִּילָֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai ledin nitlē mikkol goy hivdilanu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has distinguished us from every nation regarding the law of a hanged person?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי צִוָּֽנוּ לְכָל־אֲבֵדַת אַחֵֽינוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai tsivvanu lekhol avedat aḥenu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has commanded us regarding all lost objects of our brethren?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי אָמַר לְהָשִׁיב בְּכָל־כֹּחֵֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai amar lehashiv bekhol koḥenu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has said to return [those objects] with all our strength?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי גָּזַר: לֹא יִהְיוּ בִגְדֵי אִישֵֽׁינוּ לְנָשֵֽׁינוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai gazar: lo yihyu viḡdē ishenu lenashenu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has decreed that our men’s clothes not be on our women?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי רַחֲמָיו הִגִּֽיעוּ לְקַן צִפּוֹר, נִקְרָא בְמַעְגָּלֵֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai raḥamav higgi‘u leḳan tsippor, niḳra vema‘galenu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, whose mercy extends to a bird’s nest, which is encountered on our path?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי צִוָּֽנוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת מַעֲקֶה לְגַגֵּֽנוּ, יִיטַב לָֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai tsivvanu la‘asot ma‘aḳē leḡaggenu, yitav lanu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has commanded us to make a parapet for our roof, for our benefit?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי לַחֲרֹשׁ בְּשׁוֹר וּבַחֲמוֹר יַֽחַד אֲסָרָֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai laḥarosh beshor uvaḥamor yaḥad asaranu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has forbidden us to plow with an ox and an ass together?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי לַעֲשׂוֹת גְּדִילִים בִּכְסוּתֵֽינוּ צִוָּֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai la‘asot gedilim bikhsutenu tsivvanu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has enjoined us to make fringes on our clothing?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי הִזְהִיר: לֹא נָשִׂים עֲלִילוֹת בִּנְשֵׁי חֵיקֵֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai hizhir: lo nasim ‘alilot binshē ḥeḳenu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has taught [us] not to accuse our bosom wives of scandals?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי אָמַר לְהָמִית נֹאֵף וְנֹאֶֽפֶת, הֵרִים צִדְקֵֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai amar lehamit no’ef veno’efet, veherim tsidḳenu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has said to kill the adulterer and adulteress, [and] raised up our righteousness?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי הִזְהִיר: פְּצֽוּעַ דַּכָּא וּכְרוּת שָׁפְכָה לֹא יָבֹא בִּקְהָלֵֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai hizhir: petsu’a‘ dakka ukhrut shofkha lo yavo biḳhalenu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has enjoined us that the [man whose testicles are] mutilated and crushed, or cut off, may not enter our community?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי עוֹד שְׁלֹשָׁה מֵהֶם הִפְרִישׁ חֵילֵֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai ‘od shelosha mehem hifrish ḥelenu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has separated our army also from three other groups?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי מִכָּל־גּוֹי קִדְּשָֽׁנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai mikkol goy ḳiddeshanu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who has sanctified us out of all the nations?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי עוֹד בִּכְבוֹדוֹ כְּקֶֽדֶם יְחַדְּשֵֽׁנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai ‘od bikhvodo keḳedem yeḥaddeshenu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who will once again renew us as in antiquity?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי יִבְנֶה צִיּוֹן עִירֵֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai yivnē tsiyyon ‘irenu?
content.english: Who is like Adonai who will build Zion, our city?

content.hebrew: קהל: מִי כַּיוי בְּקוֹל צֹפִים כֹּֽחַ אִזְּרָֽנוּ?
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Mi kadonai beḳol tsofim ko’aḥ izzeranu?
content.english: Cong. Who is like Adonai, who has girded us with strength through the voice of the seers?

content.hebrew: חזן: כַּכָּתוּב: ק֥וֹל צֹפַ֛יִךְ נָ֥שְׂאוּ ק֖וֹל יַחְדָּ֣ו יְרַנֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֣י עַ֤יִן בְּעַ֨יִן֨ יִרְא֔וּ בְּשׁ֥וּב יו֖י צִיּֽוֹן:
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Kakkatuv: Ḳol tsofayikh nase’u ḳol yaḥdav yerannenu ki ‘ayin be‘ayin yir’u beshuv Adonai tsiyyon:
content.english: Cantor. As it is written: The voice of the watchers—they have raised their voice, they sing together; for they will see eye to eye when Adonai returns to Zion! (Isa. 52:8)

content.hebrew: כִּֽי־בָנָ֣ה יו֣י צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ:
content.transliteration: Ki vana Adonai tsiyyon nir’a bikhvodo:
content.english: For Adonai has built Zion; He is seen in His Glory. (Ps. 102:17)

content.hebrew: קהל: בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבֽוֹד־יו֖י מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ:
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Barukh kevod Adonai mimmeḳomo:
content.english: Cong. Blessed be Adonai’s Glory from His place. (Ezek. 3:1)
